# VibeTree

> Run AI coding agents in parallel, one isolated git worktree each. A free, MIT licensed desktop app, web app, and CLI. Works with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Aider, opencode, and any other terminal program.

VibeTree gives every agent its own git worktree: an isolated checkout with its own branch and a persistent terminal, so several agents can work on one repository without touching each other's files. Sessions live on a local server and survive reloads and reconnects. Everything runs on the user's machine; there is no cloud component and no telemetry.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://sahithvibudhi.github.io/vibe-tree/docs/): install on macOS, Windows, or Linux, open a project, create a worktree, launch an agent
- [Run the server anywhere](https://sahithvibudhi.github.io/vibe-tree/docs/server.html): standalone server on a VM or home server, auth, phone pairing, remote access
- [CLI](https://sahithvibudhi.github.io/vibe-tree/docs/cli.html): the vibetree command line client, commands, flags
- [Worktree hooks](https://sahithvibudhi.github.io/vibe-tree/docs/hooks.html): post-create and pre-remove scripts, environment variables
- [Configuration](https://sahithvibudhi.github.io/vibe-tree/docs/config.html): server environment variables, project agent presets, keyboard shortcuts
- [Troubleshooting](https://sahithvibudhi.github.io/vibe-tree/docs/troubleshooting.html): common issues and fixes
